content: PushDeer (github.com/easychen/pushdeer, fetched 2026-08): open-source self-hostable push; PROJECT UNMAINTAINED per official README notice (recommends ServerChan3); official API still runs. iOS via App Clip (no install), Mac/Android clients, IoT DeerESP. Push: POST /message/push with pushkey (multi-key comma, 10 online/100 self-host), text + desp (second section), type=text|markdown|image (default markdown; image type puts URL in text). Key model: device registration (Apple/WeChat login) then key gen/rename/regen/remove; message list API (max 100), message remove/clean. Self-host needs annual push-cert renewal. No two-way.
